However, the hypothesis extends these findings from corrosion resistance to high-temperature steam oxidation under LOCA conditions, which is not explicitly tested in the cited work, representing a minor gap.
premises: AlNbTiZr MEA coatings with ~10 at.% Al form a dense oxide layer of Nb2Zr6O17 and ZrO2
This oxide layer provides the best corrosion resistance and minimum oxygen penetration depth
The coating can be deposited by RF magnetron co-sputtering on Zr-alloy substrates
The coating is suitable for PWR cladding due to low neutron cross-section elements and good adhesion
